relationships.name: The Linux Foundation
relationships.label: Neutral host
relationships.title: TRACE Specification is an LF Project
relationships.description: TRACE is hosted at the Linux Foundation as its own series. Its specification, IP, trademark, and conformance mark sit with the series under the Community Specification License and LF Projects policies, so no single vendor decides what conformance means.

relationships.name: OPAQUE Systems
relationships.label: Founding engineering and infrastructure sponsor
relationships.description: OPAQUE provides funding, engineering time, infrastructure, and confidential-computing contributions. Sponsorship does not confer ownership of AgenTrust projects or governance authority over their technical decisions.

relationships.name: Microsoft
relationships.label: Open-source project home
relationships.description: Microsoft hosts the Agent Governance Toolkit, the open runtime-governance foundation that the AgenTrust trust chain builds on.

relationships.name: Technology Innovation Institute
relationships.label: Confirmed founding partner
relationships.description: TII is the confirmed AgenTrust founding partner anchoring the work in sovereign-AI deployment requirements.

relationships.name: AMD
relationships.label: Founding member and hardware partner
relationships.description: AMD is a founding partner of AgenTrust. AMD and OPAQUE published a joint implementation blueprint for hardware-backed Confidential AI, and the implementation verifies SEV-SNP report signatures to the AMD root.

relationships.name: Intel
relationships.label: Founding member and hardware partner
relationships.description: Intel is a founding partner of AgenTrust. The implementation verifies Intel TDX DCAP v4 quotes to the pinned Intel SGX Root CA, hardware-validated on GCP C3.

relationships.name: ServiceNow
relationships.label: OPAQUE customer implementation
relationships.description: OPAQUE publicly documents how ServiceNow used its Confidential AI Platform to reduce commission-inquiry workflows from days to seconds.

relationships.name: CSA Agentic Trust Framework
relationships.label: Public framework collaboration
relationships.description: ATF's author publicly supports positioning AGT as a reference implementation and invited implementation input into the conformance specification.

relationships.name: XRSI — Human Intelligence In The Loop
relationships.label: Ecosystem partner
relationships.title: Governance and Ecosystem Sustainability Partner
relationships.description: XRSI brings governance, community-building, and long-term ecosystem sustainability expertise to the AgenTrust adoption programme.

relationships.name: Action State Group
relationships.label: Technical collaborator
relationships.title: Trust Registry and Verifiable Record Collaboration
relationships.description: Action State Group is collaborating with AgenTrust on an open contribution path for the TRACE Trust Registry, connecting TRACE runtime evidence with neutral, independently verifiable record and witness infrastructure.
